symptoms: Asymmetrical blotchy mottle chlorosis across leaf midribs (yellowing)
Yellow vein corking and small, upright chlorotic leaves
Lopsided, small, bitter fruit with inverted coloration (green at bottom)
Progressive twig dieback and systemic tree decline
risk_factors: Asian Citrus Psyllid (Diaphorina citri) insect vectors
Movement of uncertified citrus nursery stock
prevention: Plant strictly certified disease-free nursery trees
Scout for and suppress Asian citrus psyllid populations with systemic insecticides
recommended_actions: Remove infected trees promptly to prevent vector spread to adjacent groves
Apply balanced foliar micronutrients to support remaining root system
